ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; the visible surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to less than 5% of the surface area at the lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform low-intensity field; high-contrast white clusters are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; central and mid-lobe regions are solid dark with no discernible mottling visible through water spray.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression; wide internal angle estimated at 140 degrees with minimal vertical depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge; the left lobe displays a series of high-frequency, small-amplitude serrations (peaks); the right lobe trailing edge appears more continuous with fewer distinct peaks visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering sharply towards the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-contrast white circular pixel groups on the far right fluke tip; similar but smaller clusters on the far left fluke tip margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged, irregular profile on the left fluke tip suggesting previous tissue loss; raised white clusters consistent with barnacle colonization on the dorsal-lateral edge of the right tip.
